ORDINANCE N

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District symbols as shown on Map No. 1-J

in the area bounded by:
West Huron Street; a line 97 feet west of and parallel to North Avers Avenue; the
public alley next south of and parallel to West Huron Street; a line 121 feet west of and

parallel to North Avers Avenue.

To those of RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 3843 W. Huron Street
